dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed along the central dorsal axis and lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between slightly pigmented mottled regions and the lighter baseline canvas.
